scripts.build:core: npm run build --workspace @lionpocket/core && npm run build:local-sync
scripts.mobile:start: npm run build:core && npm run start --workspace @lionpocket/mobile
scripts.mobile:android: npm run build:core && npm run android --workspace @lionpocket/mobile
scripts.mobile:build:android: npm run build:core && npm run build:android --workspace @lionpocket/mobile
scripts.start: npm run build:core && npm run start --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build:core && npm run package --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.make: npm run build:core && npm run make --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.make:linux: npm run build:core && npm run make:linux --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.publish: npm run build:core && npm run publish --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @lionpocket/core && npm run lint --workspace apps/desktop && npm run lint --workspace @lionpocket/mobile && npm run lint --workspace @lionpocket/sync-protocol && npm run lint --workspace @lionpocket/sync-local && npm run lint --workspace @lionpocket/sync-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/desktop && npm run typecheck --workspace @lionpocket/mobile && npm run typecheck --workspace @lionpocket/sync-protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @lionpocket/sync-local && npm run typecheck --workspace @lionpocket/sync-server && npm run release:typecheck && npm run sync:self-hosted:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspace @lionpocket/core && npm run test --workspace apps/desktop && npm run test --workspace @lionpocket/mobile && npm run test --workspace @lionpocket/sync-protocol && npm run test --workspace @lionpocket/sync-local && npm run test --workspace @lionpocket/sync-server && npm run test:release
scripts.mobile:build:android:release: npm run build:core && npm run build:android:release --workspace @lionpocket/mobile
scripts.build:local-sync: npm run build --workspace @lionpocket/sync-protocol && npm run build --workspace @lionpocket/sync-local
scripts.sync:dev:server: npm run build:local-sync && npm run start --workspace @lionpocket/sync-server
scripts.sync:dev:test: npm run build:local-sync && LIONPOCKET_SYNC_INTEGRATION=1 npm run test --workspace @lionpocket/sync-server
